finding: Contract-group bottom candidates are appended after existing quarter-turn generation. Incrementally rotating the four new candidates yields sixteen locally valid offers, but merely retaining old offers does not preserve the packer's successful complete plan.

retained_changes.api: append_rigid_zone_orientations accepts an optional first_original index. Only that original suffix is rotated; the complete existing prefix and indices remain unchanged. Existing callers default to zero, preserving their behavior.
retained_changes.tests: Independent real named-pad positions/extents and signed triangle area for mixed-face turns; supports two-pad capacitors and collinear IC pin rows. Full local contracts, mirrored-document binding, real authored pad-net identities, deterministic candidates, prefix retention, exact instrumented suffix operation counts, empty suffix and invalid suffix are checked.
retained_changes.production_integration: Automatic expansion of contract-group offers was removed after the global regression. No new production strategy flag or validator relaxation.

rejected_integration.result: The legalizer rejects a stale X separation, and its existing perpendicular-order retry finds a Y negative cycle. The previously qualified outline no longer constructs. This disproves the assumption that appending locally valid offers is globally non-regressing.

restored_reference.timing_limits: Short sequential screens, not matched Python measurements or a speedup claim. Full qualification was not repeated for an unused optional API parameter; the earlier integrated qualification remains tied to its recorded code revision.

next_design_requirement: A bounded strategy portfolio must preserve a successfully constructed complete incumbent, not just the shape list. Try alternative offer sets only after the incumbent strategy fails, or compare completed validated models. Retain all failed-attempt operation accounting and failure receipts; do not silently rerun or discard costs.
